title: Wanaka in Aug
meta_desc: Discover the best of Wanaka in August with kids, from skiing to lake activities, with a budget of $250-450/day for a family of 4, suitable for all ages.
intro: Wanaka in August is a winter wonderland, perfect for families who love skiing and the outdoors. With a budget of $250-450/day for a family of 4, you can enjoy the best of Wanaka, from skiing at Treble Cone to exploring the town's quirky attractions like Puzzling World. The weather is cool, with average highs of 8°C, making it ideal for outdoor activities like skiing, kayaking, or paddleboarding on Lake Wanaka.

sections.heading: Weather and What's On
sections.body:
August is one of the coolest months in Wanaka, with average highs of 8°C and lows of 0°C. It's a great time to enjoy winter sports like skiing and snowboarding. The Treble Cone Ski Area is open, and it's a great spot for families with older kids. If you're not into skiing, you can still enjoy the beautiful scenery and take a stroll along the Wanaka Lakeshore walk, which is free and suitable for all ages.

Wanaka is relatively quiet in August, with fewer crowds than in the peak summer months. This makes it an ideal time to visit popular attractions like Puzzling World and the Wanaka Lavender Farm, which are suitable for all ages and cost around $20-$30 per person.
list: Treble Cone Ski Area: open from June to October, with lift tickets starting from $120 per person
Wanaka Lavender Farm: open daily from 9am to 5pm, with admission prices around $10-$20 per person
Puzzling World: open daily from 8:30am to 6pm, with admission prices around $20-$30 per person

sections.heading: Best Activities for Families
sections.body:
Wanaka has plenty of activities that are perfect for families, from skiing and snowboarding to exploring the town's quirky attractions. The Rippon Vineyard Picnic is a great spot for a free, BYO picnic, with stunning views of the lake and surrounding mountains.

For older kids (7+), the Diamond Lake and Rocky Mountain track is a great option, with stunning views of Lake Wanaka and the Matukituki Valley. The track takes around 3 hours to complete and is a 20-minute drive from Wanaka. Kayak and paddleboard rentals are also available on Lake Wanaka, with prices starting from $20-$50 per hour.
list: Rippon Vineyard Picnic: free, BYO, with stunning views of the lake and surrounding mountains
Diamond Lake and Rocky Mountain track: 3-hour loop, 20 minutes from Wanaka, suitable for kids 7+
Lake Wanaka kayak/paddleboard rental: prices starting from $20-$50 per hour

sections.heading: Practical Tips for Families
sections.body:
Wanaka is a relatively small town, and most attractions are within walking distance or a short drive away. However, it's still important to plan ahead and book your accommodations and activities in advance, especially during peak winter months.

Make sure to pack warm clothing, including jackets, gloves, and hats, as it can get very cold in August. Don't forget to check the weather forecast before heading out, and consider purchasing a ski pass or lift tickets in advance to avoid queues.
